message.content:
Berlin is **9 hours ahead** of Los Angeles.

| Location | Standard Time | Daylight‑Saving Time |
|----------|---------------|----------------------|
| Los Angeles (Pacific Time) | UTC‑8 | UTC‑7 |
| Berlin (Central European Time) | UTC+1 | UTC+2 |

Because both regions shift forward by one hour at roughly the same time of year, the 9‑hour offset stays constant throughout the year. Thus, when it’s 12:00 pm in Los Angeles, it’s 9:00 pm in Berlin.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?" They want the time difference. We need to consider daylight saving changes. Los Angeles is in Pacific Time (PT), which is UTC-8 standard, UTC-7 DST. Berlin is Central European Time (CET) UTC+1 standard, UTC+2 DST. So difference is 9 hours during standard time (Los Angeles UTC-8 vs Berlin UTC+1 => +9). During DST, Los Angeles UTC-7 vs Berlin UTC+2 => +9 as well. Actually both shift by one hour, so difference remains 9 hours. But we should confirm if there are any differences due to DST start dates. Typically, both shift at similar times but not exactly same day. But difference remains 9 hours. So answer: Berlin is 9 hours ahead of Los Angeles. Provide explanation. No function call needed.
